program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    stripe_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            stripe_cells.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == value for r in range(h)):
            stripe_cells.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in stripe_cells:
        result[r][c] = 2
    return result
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
ns={}
exec(p.read_text(),ns)
